content.title: Water Restriction Variances and Appeal
content.summary: Property owners with 1 acre or more can apply for a water budget variance to manage their water use, with applications due by June 30, 2026. Approved variances will be valid from May 1 to October 31, 2026, but properties must still reduce water use by 20% and adhere to other restrictions. Additionally, individuals who receive a water restrictions violation can appeal within 30 days by providing a reason for the appeal, after which a hearing will be scheduled.
content.body:
## 1-acre or more property watering budget variance

***Applications are due no later than June 30, 2026.***

This variance will only be allowed for properties of 1 acre or more who require accommodations to manage their water use.**Properties will still be required to reduce water use by 20% and maintain a water budget.**

An approved variance will only be valid May 1, 2026 through October 31, 2026. Applicants must still follow other water restrictions, including:

- No watering between 10am to 6pm
- Fix broken sprinklers and any other causes of water waste immediately

Any water use over the allowed budget may be subject to repeal of the variance and enforcement in accordance with Arvada City Code. Follow up inspections may be conducted. 

Set up a profile and **apply through the [Arvada Permits webpage]([NEW PORTAL URL])**using the **Water Budget Variance by June 30, 2026**. More information on [how to create a profile is available on this webpage.](/599)

## Appeals process

If you have received a water restrictions violation from the City, you may submit an appeal. The following requirements apply to the appeals process:

- Submit within 30 days of receiving the violation.
- Submit a reason for the appeal.
- A hearing will be scheduled with the City of Arvada.

[**File a water restrictions violation appeal.**](https://arvada.form.transform.civicplus.com/64676)
